## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if any.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any limitations. Code checks are not model-quality evidence.

## Data and experiment impact

- Does this change inputs, references, prompts, dependencies, scoring, or model identity?
- If applicable, link the new version and provenance; preserve frozen evidence.
- Confirm that new data has documented terms and contains no private information, secrets, weights, or paid-run outputs.

Write "not applicable" when there is no data or experiment change.
